description: This file defines the core service for a React-based agent system, including error handling, tool setup, and the main agent loop with various utility functions.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent errors, with different error types and messages.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main service class implementing the core logic of the React agent, including running the agent loop, tool setup, and utility functions.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Main method to execute the agent loop, processing user input and managing steps.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's step list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the available tools for the agent, such as file reading/writing, time retrieval, and calculation.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a mathematical expression string into components.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction in expressions.

methods.name: _pT
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division in expressions.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors, including parentheses and unary minus.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Executes a specified tool action based on the parsed command.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses the action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses arguments from a string, handling quotes and commas.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content enclosed within specific XML tags from a string.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates the initial system prompt with available tools and instructions.
